title: Gift Delivery Ecommerce System
summary: Multi-role e-commerce web platform isolating customer ordering, vendor fulfillment, and administrator operations through strict MVC architecture and SQLite relational integrity.
problem_statement: Coordinating product catalog updates, inventory reservations, and delivery routing across distinct customer and vendor actors without state drift or race conditions.
architecture_overview: Model-View-Controller architecture segregating presentation templates, view controllers, and ORM query logic. Custom permission decorators enforce role boundaries across admin, vendor, and customer dashboards.
database_design: SQLite schema with relational foreign keys establishing strict integrity between Orders, LineItems, Products, and VendorProfiles with automatic cascade handling.

verifiable_metrics.value: ACID compliance via Django ORM transactions
